senses.gloss:
हुम् हुम्, ind. (cf. हूम्; an imitative sound
used as a particle) expressive of remembrance,
doubt, interrogation, assent, anger, aversion, reproach,
fear, (see हूम्); a mystical syllable occurring fre-
quently in spells and incantations; (in Vedic ritual)
a sacrificial exclamation used immediately before the
singing of the Pra-stāva or prelude as well as during
the chanting of the Prati-hāra or response.
—हुङ्-
कार, अस्, m. the word or sound हुम्, making the
sound हुम्, uttering a menacing sound; the grunt-
ing or roaring of a boar; any roaring, bellowing;
[]
the noise or twang (of a bow).
—हुङ्कार-गर्भ,
अस्, आ, अम्, filled with groaning or menacing sounds.
—हुङ्कार-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—हुङ्-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uttered with a mystical sound,
pronounced as an incantation; roared; (अम्), n. an
incantation; the roar or grunt of a wild boar; the
roar (of thunder); any roar.
—हुङ्-कृति, इस्, f. =
हुङ्-कार above.
—हुम्-फड्-अन्त, आस्, m. pl.,
scil. मन्त्राः, incantations ending in the mystical
words हुम् and फट्.

हूम् हूम्, ind. (cf. ॐ, हुम्, an imitative
sound used as a particle) expressive of doubt or
consideration (equivalent to humph! umph! &c.);
of interrogation (hey? indeed? eh?); of assent
(yes, aye, well, exactly, so be it; see ॐ, p. 189);
of anger, menace, aversion, repulse (avaunt! away!
begone! tush! forbear! be silent! hush!); of re-
proach, contempt (fie! shame!); of fear (ah! oh!);
a magical or mystical monosyllable, (see हुम्.)
—हूङ्-कार, अस्, m. the word or sound हूम्
(uttered disrespectfully or menacingly); uttering the
sound हूम्; roaring, grunting.
—हूङ्-कृति, इस्, f.
making the sound हूम्; grunting, groaning; a
sound made in sleeping; disrespect, insult.
